questions.q: Change to Passive: 'She is writing an essay.'
options: An essay has been written by her.
An essay is being written by her.
An essay is written by her.
An essay was written by her.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous active -> 'is being written' in passive.
questions.subject: English

questions.q: Change to Passive: 'Somebody has stolen my watch.'
options: My watch was stolen by somebody.
questions.explanation: Indefinite agent 'somebody' is dropped in passive voice.

questions.q: Change to Passive: 'Open the gate.'
questions.explanation: Imperative sentence -> 'Let + Object + be + V3'.

questions.q: Change to Indirect: He said, 'I shall go to Delhi tomorrow.'
options: He told he shall go to Delhi next day.
He said that he will go to Delhi tomorrow.
He says he would go to Delhi.
He said that he would go to Delhi the next day.
questions.explanation: 'shall' -> 'would', 'tomorrow' -> 'the next day' in Indirect Speech.

questions.q: Change to Indirect: The captain said, 'Bravo! You have played well.'
options: The captain said bravo they played well.
The captain exclaimed with joy that they played.
The captain applauded them saying that they had played well.
The captain told them well played.
questions.explanation: 'Bravo!' changes to 'applauded + object + saying that...'.

questions.q: Change to Indirect: She asked me, 'Can you drive a car?'
options: She told me could I drive a car.
She asked me that if I could drive a car.
She asked me I can drive a car.
She asked me if I could drive a car.

questions.q: Fill in modal: Walk carefully lest you _____ stumble.
